prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: isolated subject layer for a Hearts of Iron IV decision-category icon; final consumer canvas is 52x40.
Primary request: Create one original border-administration emblem: two sturdy boundary posts joined by a thick horizontal checkpoint barrier with a broad central lock plate, all arranged as a compact, readable single symbol. Give the posts and barrier clear sculpted surfaces and dark separations so the emblem remains distinct at 52x40. The subject must fill about 46x34 pixels when fitted into the final canvas.
Input images: Image 1 and Image 2 are vanilla decision-category icons used only for painted material, value contrast, and edge treatment. Do not copy their symbols or round frames; the subject will be placed over a separate 52x40 background layer.
Style/medium: painted HOI4 category emblem with aged steel, clear relief, and simple high-contrast shapes.
Composition/framing: centered horizontal emblem, fully contained within a 46x34 subject area, with at least a 3-pixel transparent margin on the 52x40 canvas.
Lighting/mood: directional pale highlights on raised metal and dark recesses for strong separation against a blue category backing.
Color palette: warm bronze highlights, pale steel, charcoal shadows; use no bright neon colors.
Materials/textures: lightly weathered metal with crisp painted edges, sparse detail that remains readable at native size.
Constraints: generate only the isolated subject with a genuinely transparent background; no medallion, roundel, coin, border, frame, button, extra backing, scenery, map, flags, text, watermark, or checkerboard. Do not trace or reproduce either reference.
Avoid: thin wires or bars, low-contrast pale silhouettes, oversized empty areas, clipped parts, white matte, halo, coloured spill, or transparent holes inside solid shapes.
